content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IRCTC Tourism Monitor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for IRCTC Tourism Monitor posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the IRCTC Tourism Monitor posts is scheduled for 8th and 9th September 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue on these dates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Tourism Monitor post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a 3-Years Bachelor degree in Tourism, or a 3-Years bachelor degree in any stream with a 1-year diploma in Travel & Tourism, or a 3-years Bachelor Degree in any stream with a 2-years Post Graduation Degree/Diploma in Travel & Tourism.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to the Tourism Monitor position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Tourism Monitor post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Tourism Monitor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a total CTC ranging from Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 35,000/- per month, inclusive of statutory deductions.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Tourism Monitor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies for the Tourism Monitor post announced by IRCTC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the IRCTC Tourism Monitor recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Tourism Monitor position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview, Document Verification, Personal Interview, and finally the preparation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for IRCTC Tourism Monitor recruitment being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the IRCTC office in New Delhi. The specific address and timings will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job offered for the Tourism Monitor post is on a contractual basis.
